comments.story: Lab mice have a chill, and that may be messing up study results (2016)
comments.text: The claim is that the walls can be hotter than the room around it. By the second law of thermodynamics, heat doesn't naturally move from a cooler object to a hotter object, or as Flanders and Swann would put it, "heat don't move from a cooler to a hotter" ( [VIDEO] ) [1]
